units.source_text: 大竹七段下黑5，花了二十分钟。

en.t: Otake 7-dan played Black 5, taking twenty minutes.

units.source_text: 名人紧跟着下白6，费了四十一分钟。

en.t: The Meijin immediately followed with White 6, spending forty-one minutes.

units.source_text: 这局棋头一次出现长考。

en.t: This was the first long think of the game.

units.source_text: 事先商定，今天下午四点轮到谁下谁就封盘。

en.t: They had agreed beforehand that whoever was to move at four o'clock that afternoon would seal the move.

units.source_text: 七段在差两分钟四点时，下了黑11。

en.t: At two minutes before four, the 7-dan played Black 11.

units.source_text: 在剩下的两分钟内，如若名人不下，就封盘了。

en.t: If the Meijin did not play within the remaining two minutes, the move would be sealed.

units.source_text: 名人紧跟白12，四点二十二分封盘了。

en.t: The Meijin promptly played White 12, and the game was sealed at 4:22.
